about: The design mistakes an agent made in the lab's 15 design attempts (cluster I, PE-2), each with the plan it is in and the ids of the parts that are wrong. Grid names a mistake when anything it says (a drawing issue, a door warning or a rules finding) is about one of those parts. The lab counted 9 mistakes and said Grid's notes pointed at 2. Mistakes 8 and 9 are our reading of the lab's notes; the lab does not list the nine one by one.

mistakes.mistake: the floor left over went into the bathroom, far bigger than asked
the bathroom window runs across the new utility-room partition
the bedroom door sits past the end of the hall and joins bedroom to bathroom
the same door now straddles the hall's end wall
a wall typed 10 cm off: the hall too narrow, the bathroom too wide
the plot drawn as a room of four dividing lines
a bedroom with no outside wall
a window's sill and height guessed wrong from a picture
moved partitions left two windows and an opening cut by the walls
